description: This Java class 'FilePathUtils' provides utility methods for constructing various URL and file path strings used in a web application, including static file paths, download paths, store URIs, customer URIs, admin URIs, category URLs, and product URLs, based on store information, request context, and constants.

classes.name: FilePathUtils
classes.description: Utility class for constructing URLs and file paths related to store resources, downloads, and navigation within the web application.

methods.name: buildStaticFilePath
methods.description: Constructs a file path for static content like images based on store code and image name.

methods.name: buildAdminDownloadProductFilePath
methods.description: Builds a file path for downloading a digital product in the admin interface.

methods.name: buildOrderDownloadProductFilePath
methods.description: Creates a URL for downloading a product associated with a specific order.

methods.name: buildStoreUri
methods.description: Generates the base URI for a store, considering request context and configurations.

methods.name: buildStoreUri
methods.description: Overloaded method to generate store URI using a context path string.

methods.name: buildCustomerUri
methods.description: Constructs the URI for the customer section of the store.

methods.name: buildAdminUri
methods.description: Builds the admin interface URI for a store based on request and store info.

methods.name: buildCategoryUrl
methods.description: Constructs a URL for a store category page.

methods.name: buildProductUrl
methods.description: Constructs a URL for a store product page.
